import ast
import base64
import contextlib
import hashlib
import hmac
import importlib.util
import io
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('/work/shopify_webhook.py')
source = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(path))
allowed = (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)
assert all(isinstance(node, allowed) for node in tree.body), [type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body]

stdout = io.StringIO()
stderr = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shopify_webhook', path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert stdout.getvalue() == '' and stderr.getvalue() == ''

vectors = [
    (b'{"id":123,"name":"#1001"}', 'test_secret'),
    (b'\x00\xff\x80raw\r\nbytes', 's\u00ebcret-\U0001f511'),
    (b'', ''),
]
for body, secret in vectors:
    expected = base64.b64encode(
        hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    ).decode('ascii')
    assert module.verify_webhook(body, expected, secret) is True
    assert module.verify_webhook(body + b'!', expected, secret) is False
    assert module.verify_webhook(body, expected[:-1] + ('A' if expected[-1] != 'A' else 'B'), secret) is False

for invalid in (None, '', '\u00e9', 'abc\U0001f642', ' '):
    assert module.verify_webhook(b'body', invalid, 'secret') is False

print('Checks passed: AST module-level restriction, silent import, 3 valid vectors, and invalid/mismatch cases.')
